snippet.title: HAX | Official Trailer for Meta Quest
snippet.description:
(Launching Today at 6pm EST 1/30/25)

AVAILABLE NOW!

META HORIZON STORE
https://www.meta.com/experiences/hax/6859561550801843/
Meta Quest 2 | Meta Quest 3S | Meta Quest 3

Battle as robots with digital weapons in this dystopian, multiplayer, arena shooter. Earn your rank, unlock new weapons and attachments, customize your character, hack the enemy, and wield an array of light-swords. With ground-breaking weapon mechanics, HAX brings something new to VR shooters, while staying true to one of the greatest game genres of all time.

Built from the ground up, specifically for Mobile VR, HAX offers highly intuitive controls, groundbreaking weapon mechanics, super-sampled graphics, and dedicated servers. Customize your weapons, attachments, characters, camos and more. Earn your rank insignia and wear it for all to see as you climb your way to the top of the leaderboards.

Humans have mysteriously disappeared leaving two warring, robot factions; The UNR (United Nations Robotics), a peace keeping division who will stop at nothing, they will even use force to spread peace; and the 404, a corrupt military group spreading their infectious code.

What is HAX? It’s a radioactive, programmable gas used to power weapons and hack other robots by firing data packets. One simple HAX Mag can be loaded into a firearm, turned into a sword, thrown as a grenade, or used to hack objectives and other players. This all-in-one Mag makes HAX incredibly easy to learn and fun to play.

HAX is an early access, live-service game built by a three-person team based in Colorado USA, called Engine Organic Ltd.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY:
X: https://x.com/HAX_VR
Discord: https://discord.gg/XjsSVQKRwt
Website: https://www.engineorganic.com/hax

SEO: HAX, VR, FPS, Gaming, MetaQuest, Quest2, Quest3, Quest3S, Mobile VR, Virtual Reality, Engine Organic, Multiplayer, First Person Shooter, Arena Shooter, Robots, PvP, Online Shooter.
